in_hebrew.name: חילדה
in_hebrew.long_meaning: The Hebrew name Hildy (חילדה) is derived from the Hebrew word chilul (חילול), which means 'maiden' or 'young woman'. It is a name that celebrates the youth and beauty of a woman.

in_greek.name: Ἱλδε
in_greek.long_meaning: The Greek name Hildy (Ἱλδε) is derived from the Greek word hilas (Ἱλασ), which means 'pledge' or 'hostage'. In ancient Greece, a hilas was a battle maiden, a woman who served as a pledge of good faith in negotiations or as a hostage in times of war.

in_latin.name: Hildi
in_latin.long_meaning: The Latin name Hildi (Hildi) is derived from the Old Norse word hild, which means 'battle'. The name Hildi, therefore, means 'battle woman'.
